title: HOS Commands 0.2 approval
description: Draft. A person's decision on a command: approved or rejected. An approval names a role of the tenant, records who decided and under which role, expires, and carries the digest of the command its approver saw: a command changed afterwards no longer matches, and the approval is invalid. An approval is a document, recorded in the journal beside the command. HOS 0.2 does not sign approvals: the gateway authenticates its approvers, and signatures are left to Trust 0.3.

hosapprovalversion.description: HOS version the approval conforms to. A document with this member is an approval.

command_digest.description: The digest of the command its approver saw.

hostenant.description: Must be the tenant of the command.

expires_at.description: After this instant an approval no longer authorizes the command. Required for an approval that approves.

policy.description: The policy in force when the approver decided.
